findings: Production writer of SCORE_SNAPSHOTS_PATH/data/score_snapshots.json at pin: save_score_snapshot (:110-116) only. Sole production call site: _build_and_save :298 inside write_full_universe_snapshot. revive_score_snapshot_scheduler does not write the file; it run_once → write path. Tests also call save_score_snapshot (out of product scope).
save_score_snapshot always writes tmp then os.replace(tmp, snap_path) (:113-116). Successful replace advances final-path mtime (new content just written to tmp).

Orphan late-complete: FuturesTimeoutError sets caller_abandoned and returns write_timeout (:383-390) while build continues; comment :333 late completion benign; on success _build_and_save still reaches save_score_snapshot (:298) → mtime refreshes.

Partial replace: no mid-build replace. save only after build_full_universe_snapshot returns into _build_and_save. Exception before :298 ⇒ no replace/mtime change. Whether build_full_universe_snapshot can return a sparse-but-complete payload is a separate question; the write itself is always a full json.dump of the given payload.

snapshot_age_seconds (:92-95) = now - getmtime. rank_subnets_by_snapshot returns None when age is None or age>SCORE_SNAPSHOT_MAX_AGE_SECONDS (default 7200) (:143-146). Fresher mtime → smaller age → can flip stale(None) to fresh ranked list.
